description: Record how applications are going after they were sent: applied, callback, phone_screen, interview, offered, rejected or no_response. Pass 1 to 25 application_ids from getmattered_get_applications and the stage. It changes only the stage on the user's own application tracker: nothing is sent to the employer, and the stage can be set again with this tool. Set it only from what the user tells you. Do not use it to approve, reject or cancel an application; use getmattered_approve_applications, getmattered_reject_applications or getmattered_cancel_applications. Next: getmattered_generate_interview_questions for an interview stage.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from getmattered_get_applications

stage.description: The stage to record: applied, callback, phone_screen, interview, offered, rejected or no_response.

name: getmattered_set_application_stage

decision.description: The operation that ran: approve, reject, cancel, refine, re_prepare or set_stage.

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action. Never proof the employer received it.

title: Record Application Stage
